COLONOSCOPY REPORT
Date of service: November 9, 2026
Endoscopist: Helena Varga, MD (fictional)
History: Crohn disease with an ileocolonic anastomosis. At the 2024 colonoscopy the anastomosis was narrowed, but no dilation was performed.
Procedure: The colonoscope was advanced to the ileocolonic anastomosis, which was narrowed to 9 mm. The anastomotic stricture was dilated
today with a 15 mm through-the-scope balloon, after which the colonoscope passed into the neo-terminal ileum, which was examined for 10 cm.
Impression: Anastomotic stricture dilated to 15 mm today.
